AC AMENDMENTS (plan-review F1 critical + cross-story dep):

**Cross-story dependency**: T6 NOW depends on S2.T2 (0244-81c4-340a-4cb7 — cycle_ledger.py v1.2.0 + pr_number signature). Link added.

**Post-S2 append_cycle call**: aggregator.py calls append_cycle with the post-S2 signature: append_cycle(path, cycle_num, findings_tuples, pr_number=<int>, commit_sha=<sha>, findings_hash, halt_reason=None). T6 implementation MUST use this signature.

**Failure-mode handlers** (per F4):
- Aggregation LLM malformed output: catch JSON parse error \xe2\x86\x92 post per-cluster results un-aggregated with visibility comment 'aggregation-failure: posting per-cluster results'. Continue processing.
- .gitattributes parse failure (file_filter): fail-OPEN (include all files); emit warning.
- Per-file schema exhaustion: skip the file in aggregator output; emit 'schema-correction-exhausted: <file>' marker.

- [ ] Aggregator uses post-S2 append_cycle signature
  Verify: grep -qE 'append_cycle.*pr_number=|append_cycle\(.*pr_number' plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/aggregator.py
- [ ] Failure-mode handlers implemented
  Verify: grep -cE 'aggregation.failure|schema.correction.exhaust|fail.open' plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/aggregator.py | awk '{exit ($1>=2?0:1)}'
